system.description:
Cost: 1 Resolve

Range: 10 spaces

You inflict a creature with an infectious disease that spreads and worsens endlessly.

Choose a creature within 10 spaces. That target becomes Contaminated.

At the start of that creature's turn, make a 4:1 Soul (Metaphysics) check resisted by the target's Resilience.

If you succeed, the target takes Damage equal to the difference in successes, this Damage ignores Armor. Otherwise, the Contaminated effect ends.

You may spend 1 Resolve at the start of your turn to sustain this effect. If you do not, the disease dies with the round.

Otherwise, all creatures adjacent to creatures that have been Contaminated by this ability also become Contaminated until the start of your next turn and is thereafter treated as an additional target of this ability.
